cards.name: Resurgent Belief
cards.oracleText:
Suspend 2—{1}{W} (Rather than cast this card from your hand, pay {1}{W} and exile it with two time counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter. When the last is removed, you may cast it without paying its mana cost.)
Return all enchantment cards from your graveyard to the battlefield. (Auras with nothing to enchant remain in your graveyard.)

cards.name: Resurrection Orb
cards.oracleText:
Equipped creature has lifelink.
Whenever equipped creature dies, return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
Equip {4} ({4}: Attach to target creature you control. Equip only as a sorcery.)

cards.name: Paradoxical Outcome
cards.oracleText: Return any number of target nonland, nontoken permanents you control to their owners' hands. Draw a card for each card returned to your hand this way.

cards.name: Response // Resurgence
cards.oracleText:
Response deals 5 damage to target attacking or blocking creature.
Creatures you control gain first strike and vigilance until end of turn. After this main phase, there is an additional combat phase followed by an additional main phase.

cards.name: Resurrected Cultist
cards.oracleText: Delirium — {2}{B}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. Activate only if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard and only as a sorcery. (If a creature with a finality counter on it would die, exile it instead.)

cards.name: Resurrection
cards.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.

cards.name: Unexpected Results
cards.oracleText: Shuffle your library, then reveal the top card. If it's a nonland card, you may cast it without paying its mana cost. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield and return Unexpected Results to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Resupply
cards.oracleText:
You gain 6 life.
Draw a card.

cards.name: Resuscitate
cards.oracleText: Until end of turn, creatures you control gain "{1}: Regenerate this creature."
